bugs.description: delete_widget attempts JSON decoding for the endpoint's successful 204 No Content response even though its contract has no response body.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: The server successfully deletes a widget and returns the documented 204 status with an empty body.
bugs.observableImpact: The client raises a decoding exception after a successful deletion, so callers treat the completed operation as failed.
bugs.provenance: Seeded removal of the explicit 204 return path. test_client.py uses a response object that enforces the no-body contract.
